**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by winning rounds. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 19 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Wild”, two “Wild Draw Four”).
• Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw** – If you have no playable card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends.
2. **Play** – Place one card from your hand onto the discard pile that matches either the color or the number/symbol of the top card.
3. **Discard** – If you play a “Wild” or “Wild Draw Four,” you must declare the new color.
4. **End Turn** – Pass play to the next player in the current direction. | | **Playable Cards** | • **Number cards** – Match color or number.
• **Draw Two** – Match color or play another Draw Two to stack.
• **Skip** – Skip the next player.
• **Reverse** – Reverse play direction.
• **Wild** – Change the active color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Change color and force the next player to draw four cards (only playable if you have no matching color). | | **Special Rules** | • **Stacking** – If a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four is played, the next player may play another of the same type to pass the penalty upward.
• **Calling “Uno”** – When you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player calls you out, you must draw two cards as a penalty.
• **Winning a Round** – The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | • Winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Draw Two, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
• If a player reaches or exceeds the target score (e.g., 500) after a round, the game ends. | | **Variations** | • **House Rules** – Many groups add house rules such as “Draw Two stacking” or “No Wild Draw Four stacking.”
• **Uno Attack** – Uses a special card dispenser that can randomly add extra cards to a player’s hand. | **Quick Play Tips** 1. **Keep a balanced hand** – Try to hold a mix of colors to avoid being stuck.
2. **Use action cards strategically** – Save “Draw Two” or “Reverse” for when you’re about to win or to disrupt opponents.
3. **Watch opponents’ colors** – If you notice a player running low on a particular color, play a Wild to force them to draw.
4. **Remember the “UNO” shout** – It’s a simple but powerful rule that can save you from a big penalty.
5. **Plan for the endgame** – As the target score approaches, consider whether you want to finish early or risk a longer game for a higher score. | Enjoy your game!
